run_scope: Fresh Taiwan-first opportunity discovery with evidence-role, externalizability, and recency gates

claim_audit.recent_buyer_signal: Two 2026 Tasker buyer requests: PDF→Excel and PDF→internal Word format.
claim_audit.value_mechanism: Observed workflow; time, correction rate, and delivery time can be measured.
claim_audit.online_acquisition: Tasker, PRO360, search content, professional communities.
weakest_claims: two listings may still be one-off projects
contradictions: customization and confidentiality may reduce margin

claim_audit.recent_buyer_signal: Two August 2026 Tasker buyer requests explicitly seek outsourcing of multi-channel invoices, reconciliation, and account workflow.
claim_audit.value_mechanism: Month-end completion, missing/duplicate items, and exception count.
contradictions: accountants and ERP already serve adjacent needs

claim_audit.externalizability_gate: PASS for category, research-more for narrow preflight wedge
claim_audit.recent_buyer_signal: Recent PRO360 customer reviews and requests for full tender proposal/consulting services.
claim_audit.value_mechanism: Time and missing-document reduction; preflight-to-quote conversion is unknown.
claim_audit.online_acquisition: PRO360, tender communities, search content, LINE groups.
weakest_claims: full proposal purchases do not prove preflight purchases

claim_audit.externalizability_gate: PASS for broader preconstruction services; exact quantity-estimation outsourcing still thin
claim_audit.recent_buyer_signal: Multiple 2026 Tasker requests for measurement, initial estimates, and quantity estimation; only one exact quantity-estimation request.
claim_audit.buyer_identified: Yes, but buyer type mixes owners and contractors.
claim_audit.value_mechanism: Potentially time/rework/quote accuracy; not yet measured.
weakest_claims: adjacent owner requests may not generalize to contractor outsourcing

claim_audit.recent_buyer_signal: No recent employer-side buyer request; only provider page plus worker-side pain.
No recent buyer-side request/review within 24 months; direct seller report is from 2018.

strongest_evidence: Two recent Tasker buyer requests for PDF/image document transformation
Two recent Tasker buyer requests explicitly seeking outsourced multi-channel account/invoice reconciliation
Recent PRO360 customer reviews and requests for Taiwan tender proposal services
weakest_claims: No budget is treated as confirmed payment
Vendor pages are marked competition only
Preflight and remote construction sub-wedges remain hypotheses even when broader categories externalize
contradictions: Existing SaaS, ERP, agencies, consultants, and internal labor are credible substitutes
Generic document automation can commoditize the first candidate
Accounting, engineering, tender, and food workflows have professional responsibility boundaries
unsupported_precision: No TAM, CAC, LTV, retention, market share, or conversion estimates
Marketplace budgets and proposal counts are reported as observed signals only
critical_unknowns: Repeat behavior after the first manual delivery
Whether one narrow document/workflow family can be standardized
Whether the founder can reach first ten buyers through marketplaces/content without cold outbound
next_evidence_to_collect: Run three non-paid intake tests: one verticalized PDF sample, one month of e-commerce reconciliation files, and one tender document. Require real file submission and a second-use request before considering any build or paid pilot.
